source: User request: all subsequently revised regular enemy troops should use an overall blue-violet design.
scope: Subsequent regular enemy troop artwork across battle scenes and map scenes. Preserve distinct profession costumes and weapons.
rules: Blue-violet is the dominant clothing and armor direction, not a mandatory tint for every pixel.
Keep skin and hair natural; retain readable wood, leather and metal accents in small areas.
Use simple shared palettes across poses, typically 10-14 colors depending on the profession.
Do not recolor by source color index alone when skin, weapons and garments share a source color.
Keep each profession's costume, silhouette, weapon, poses, timing and registration distinct.
Existing art is updated as requested; this rule does not itself batch-replace all previous enemy art or integrate assets into game packages.
